content.text: Also let me double check there aren't other classes elsewhere in guava/src (outside cache package) that implement Cache directly.

Confirmed — only three classes in `guava/src` directly declare `implements Cache<K, V>`:

1. **`AbstractCache<K, V>`** (`com.google.common.cache.AbstractCache`) — `public abstract class AbstractCache<K, V> implements Cache<K, V>`
2. **`ForwardingCache<K, V>`** (`com.google.common.cache.ForwardingCache`) — `public abstract class ForwardingCache<K, V> extends ForwardingObject implements Cache<K, V>`
3. **`LocalCache.LocalManualCache<K, V>`** (nested static class in `com.google.common.cache.LocalCache`) — `static class LocalManualCache<K, V> implements Cache<K, V>, Serializable`

Everything else (`ForwardingLoadingCache`, `AbstractLoadingCache`, `LocalCache.LocalLoadingCache`) reaches `Cache` only transitively via `LoadingCache` or by extending one of the three above.

ANSWER: `AbstractCache`, `ForwardingCache`, and `LocalCache.LocalManualCache` (nested class) are the only classes in guava/src that directly declare `implements Cache<K, V>`.
